import FreeCAD as App, Part, os, Mesh
doc = App.newDocument("Bracket")
sh = doc.addObject("Spreadsheet::Sheet","Params")
sh.set("A1","Width"); sh.set("B1","80"); sh.setAlias("B1","Width")
doc.recompute()
base = doc.addObject("Part::Box","Base"); base.Height=4; base.Width=60
base.setExpression("Length","Params.Width")
back = doc.addObject("Part::Box","Back"); back.Width=4; back.Height=50
back.setExpression("Length","Params.Width")
fuse = doc.addObject("Part::Fuse","Plates"); fuse.Base=base; fuse.Tool=back
holes=[]
for i,s in enumerate((-20,20)):
    c = doc.addObject("Part::Cylinder","Hole%d"%(i+1)); c.Radius=2.5; c.Height=4
    c.Placement = App.Placement(App.Vector(0,0,35), App.Rotation(App.Vector(1,0,0),-90))
    c.setExpression("Placement.Base.x","Params.Width/2 + (%d)"%s)
    holes.append(c)
tools = doc.addObject("Part::MultiFuse","HoleTools"); tools.Shapes=holes
cut = doc.addObject("Part::Cut","Bracket"); cut.Base=fuse; cut.Tool=tools
doc.recompute()
def rep(n):
    s=cut.Shape; b=s.BoundBox
    print(n, s.isValid(), s.Volume, b)
    for h in holes: print(h.Name, h.Shape.BoundBox)
rep("80")
d="/lab/out"
try:
    os.makedirs(d,exist_ok=True)
except Exception as e: print("mkdir",e)
def export(w):
    try: Part.export([cut],"%s/bracket-%d.step"%(d,w)); print("step ok")
    except Exception as e: print("STEP FAIL",e)
    try: Mesh.export([cut],"%s/bracket-%d.stl"%(d,w)); print("stl ok")
    except Exception as e: print("STL FAIL",e)
export(80)
sh.set("B1","100"); doc.recompute()
rep("100"); export(100)
print(os.path.abspath(d), os.listdir(d))
